deals.summary: At an extraordinary general meeting during the 2025-26 season, sole shareholder EPS (Européenne pour la Promotion du Sport), the Pinault family company, converted a EUR 110m debt it held on the club into equity; the club's share capital rose from EUR 77.5m to EUR 187.5m (the club's legal notice now gives capital of EUR 187,543,542.72).

name: Stade Rennais F.C.
notes: Every earlier source (footballgroundmap.com) was replaced. Capacity is now the club's own figure, 29,778 (the old record had 31,127 from an aggregator). Revenue, the revenue split, wages and the operating result come from the DNCG's club-by-club accounts for 2024/25, the season to 30 June 2025. They cover the SASP plus the ETP Odorico association, in thousands of euros, excluding player trading. Rennes's DNCG page uses a different layout from other clubs: player amortisation and agents' fees sit in the player-trading block, not in operating charges. Its result from player trading was +EUR 32.833m, financial result -EUR 8.025m and net result -EUR 26.997m. The page has no pre-tax line, so pretax_result is null; we do not add up figures. At 30 June 2025 the balance sheet showed shareholder current accounts of EUR 164.638m, financial debt of EUR 4.240m and cash of EUR 16.422m. No net-debt figure is stated, so net_debt is null. The valuation is Sportune's own revenue-multiple estimate, not a transaction price. Attendance is the club's figure for 2025-26 (95% full on average). Leadership is current as of the organigramme on 3 Oct 2026. Nicolas de Tavernost succeeded Guillaume Cerutti as board chair (club release, 22 May 2026); Cerutti had replaced Alban Gréget on 10 Oct 2025. The French registry lists N. Bellet de Tavernost as board chair and A. Pouille as directeur général. EPS's own registry number and its link to Artémis are not stated on any page read. The pages say only that EPS is the Pinault-owned sole shareholder and that Artémis took the club over in 1998. Honours: the club's history site gives three Coupe de France wins (1965, 1971, 2019) and no league title, so the league-titles field is left null. No social follower counts with a date were found.

ownership_summary: Owned outright by the Pinault family: its company Européenne pour la Promotion du Sport (EPS) is the club's sole shareholder, and Groupe Artémis, the Pinault family holding company, took the club over in 1998. In the 2025-26 season EPS converted EUR 110m of debt it held on the club into capital, lifting share capital from EUR 77.5m to EUR 187.5m. No outside or institutional minority investor is reported.
